page: Google Cloud Platform n4a-highcpu-64 is an arm64-based server instance belonging to the n4a server family. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. This configuration does not include local storage or integrated graphics processing units, and it is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating on an ARM architecture, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention from neighboring tenants. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a compute-heavy resource, offering qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require substantial parallel processing power but have modest memory footprints. By avoiding the overhead of bundled local storage or GPU hardware, resource allocation remains focused on raw CPU capacity.

The n4a-highcpu-64 is designed for highly parallelizable, compute-bound workloads. Suitable applications include high-performance web serving, batch processing, media encoding, distributed analytics, and CI/CD compilation pipelines optimized for ARM64 architectures.
